subject: cmdstan, select just some set of transformed parameters, memory saving

messages.author: d4ffc0256db418c1
messages.subject: cmdstan, select just some set of transformed parameters, memory saving
parts:
Hi everyone,

Despite a spent some time trying to figure out how to save just some set of parameters using cmdstan with the ADVI algoritm at the cmdstan manual, I couldn't find at any place in the manual how do it.

I am having a problem with memory when running my analysis, and it would be trivially solved with I had an option that I could select which transformed parameter I would like to keep as the iteration goes. For instance, there is an matrix  at my code with 30.000 x 30.000 elements that are used just to get a transformed parameters, that for my problem are not necessary at the output every iterations.

Anyone may help please some approach that I could select at cmdstan just the set of transformed paramaters?

Thank you very much,
Jhonathan Pedroso

On Saturday, January 7, 2017 at 6:50:17 AM UTC-5, Jhonathan Pedroso wrote:
I am having a problem with memory when running my analysis, and it would be trivially solved with I had an option that I could select which transformed parameter I would like to keep as the iteration goes. For instance, there is an matrix  at my code with 30.000 x 30.000 elements that are used just to get a transformed parameters, that for my problem are not necessary at the output every iterations.

Anyone may help please some approach that I could select at cmdstan just the set of transformed paramaters?
It is not possible in CmdStan, but you can define the big matrix in the model block rather than the transformed parameters block, and it won't get saved by any interface to Stan.
